notes: The list holds every Commander-legal card whose controller can take an extra turn. The candidates come from the Scryfall search legal:commander o:"extra turn" on 2026-09-13. Scryfall confirms every name as an exact Oracle name on the same date. The list leaves out cards that give only an opponent the extra turn (Emrakul, the Promised End; Eon Frolicker; Perch Protection). It also leaves out cards that stop extra turns (Gerrard's Hourglass Pendant, Stranglehold, Trouble in Pairs). Ugin's Nexus and Timesifter stay because they can give their controller an extra turn.
cards: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk
Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting
